abstract_sentences.text: We study spectral algorithms in the setting where kernels are learned from data.
We introduce the effective span dimension (ESD), an alignment-sensitive complexity measure that depends jointly on the signal, spectrum, and noise level σ².

evidence.anchor: depends jointly on the signal, spectrum, and noise level

abstract_sentences.text: The ESD is well-defined for arbitrary kernels and signals without requiring eigen-decay conditions or source conditions.

evidence.anchor: without requiring eigen-decay conditions or source conditions

abstract_sentences.text: We prove that for sequence models whose ESD is at most K, the minimax excess risk scales as σ² K.

evidence.anchor: minimax excess risk scales as σ² K

abstract_sentences.text: Furthermore, we analyze over-parameterized gradient flow and prove that it can reduce the ESD.

evidence.anchor: prove that it can reduce the ESD

abstract_sentences.text: This finding establishes a connection between adaptive feature learning and provable improvements in generalization of spectral algorithms.
We demonstrate the generality of the ESD framework by extending it to linear models and RKHS regression, and we support the theory with numerical experiments.

evidence.anchor: extending it to linear models and RKHS regression

abstract_sentences.text: This framework provides a novel perspective on generalization beyond traditional fixed-kernel theories.

evidence.anchor: Many modern learning procedures are adaptive
fixed spectral assumptions ... difficult to justify
we propose the Effective Span Dimension
We establish sharp minimax optimal convergence rates
successful adaptive learning can be interpreted as a reduction in ESD

claim_closure.claim: ESD quantifies signal-spectrum alignment without source or eigen-decay assumptions.
claim_closure.method_response: Definition 3.1 and span profile formalize the signal/spectrum/noise tail crossing.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 3.3 and examples relate the class to minimax difficulty.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion reiterates the dynamic, noise-dependent descriptor.

claim_closure.claim: ESD classes have sharp sequence-model minimax rates.
claim_closure.method_response: Defines FK,λ by an ESD quota.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 3.3 has PC upper and Assouad lower proofs.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion describes minimax difficulty of the ESD-bounded class.

claim_closure.claim: The framework extends to linear and RKHS regression.
claim_closure.method_response: Appendices B and C construct SVD/whitening and KPCPE bridges.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorems B.3, C.7, and C.8 state minimax results under their stated conditions.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion says ESD remains applicable when the spectrum is learned.

claim_closure.method_response: Equation (12) and strong/weak ordering mechanism specify the adaptive model.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem 5.2 and Appendix G prove the endpoint inequality; Figures 1-2 illustrate it.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Discussion limits the rigorous mechanism to fixed eigenbasis learning.

claim_closure.claim: The result gives a general theorem for adaptive learning with evolving eigenfunctions.
claim_closure.method_response: Appendix D defines pathwise ESD for time-dependent eigensystems.
claim_closure.evidence_response: A deep linear experiment tracks ESD and risk, but no general theorem is given.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: The paper explicitly leaves the general theorem for future work.

evidence.anchor: general theorem ... left for future work

claim_closure.claim: Ridge-guided complexity is an intrinsic replacement for ESD.
claim_closure.method_response: Appendix I defines a ridge saturating dimension only to diagnose saturation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Theorem I.6 and Example I.7 show it can exceed intrinsic ESD complexity.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: No contrary claim is introduced in the conclusion.

limitations.name: Population descriptor rather than training input
limitations.description: ESD is introduced for theoretical analysis and is not supplied to a training algorithm.

limitations.name: Fixed-eigenbasis theorem scope
limitations.description: The rigorous OP-GF result treats eigenvalue learning under a fixed eigenbasis.

limitations.name: Evolving-eigenfunction theorem unavailable
limitations.description: Pathwise ESD is defined and illustrated, but a general theorem for evolving eigenfunctions is deferred.

limitations.name: OP-GF condition burden
limitations.description: Theorem 5.2 requires strong/weak signal separation, pairwise conditions, and top-block spectral conditions.

limitations.name: RKHS bounded-target and regularity conditions
limitations.description: RKHS claims use a bounded target and a (K,n)-regular kernel condition; the lower-bound scope is correspondingly qualified.

limitations.name: Out-of-span target error
limitations.description: For f* outside the kernel span, the appendix adds irreducible approximation error rather than claiming it is removable by spectral regularization.

measurement_disagreements.description: The automatic preprint metric draft reported 136 displays. Direct physical-page reading shows sequential numbered equations from (1) through (137), so the inventory records at least 137 numbered displays; unnumbered display total remains uncertain.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 学习过程重排 learned kernel 的谱；当 signal energy 更集中于 leading eigencoordinates，ESD 下降，同一 target 进入较小的 minimax class，oracle spectral risk 随之下降。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 定义、sequence-model minimax result、OP-GF theorem 的条件化陈述、两张主图和 discussion 都留在主文；关键 proof 和跨模型条件移入附录。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendices A-I 承担 related-work taxonomy、linear/RKHS bridge、additional numerical checks、all main proofs、OP-GF technical chain 和 ridge saturation diagnostic。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 用一个 noise-indexed tail-energy object 同时连接 oracle estimator、minimax class、adaptive dynamics 与 controlled synthetic checks。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 关于 evolving eigenfunctions 的一般 adaptive-learning theorem 未闭合；现有证据是 pathwise definition 与深线性 illustration。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 每个 alignment-generalization 主张都应给出可计算的排序或尾能量对象、它进入 risk 的明确机制，以及一个会失败的边界情形。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 当 empirical eigensystem、data-dependent representation 或非谱型 estimator 是决定性对象时，population-level ESD 需要额外估计/证明，不能直接外推。
